Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps from today's call

Hi Samir - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment.

Call summary (5m):
- Use case: realtime payments insights + automated reconciliation at scale (high token volume, low-latency critical paths).
- Primary success criteria: reduce reconciliation cycle time by 60% and avoid manual review for high-volume flows.
- Security/controls: SOC 2, VPC peering, customer-managed KMS called out as must-haves.

Stakeholder map (as discussed):
- Product/Eng: Samir + Payment Platform team (technical champions)
- Security: Nicole Huang (mentioned as lead for questionnaire)
- Procurement: TBD (Samir said they'll loop in procurement for terms)
- Economic buyer: Alex Reyes (CFO) - needs ROI story and cost/latency guarantees

Attached: Finovate_MAPlan_draft.pdf - a lightweight mutual action plan I drafted from today's notes.

As next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement + legal contact names and an initial availability window for a procurement call (30 min).
2) We share a short ROI one-pager + champion talk track that Alex can use internally.
3) We provide security artifacts (SOC 2 report placeholder, data flow diagram) and a completed security questionnaire.

If that aligns I'll get Ethan to prepare a short champion enablement deck and a one-pager ROI summary. Thanks - happy to adjust timelines to match your procurement cadence.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Markus - drafting the materials Samir requested. Quick draft below, plus an attachment (ROI_one-pager.docx). Feel free to forward or iterate.

--- Draft champion talk track (for Alex Reyes) ---
Goal: establish predictable cost and measurable operational savings from automating reconciliation.
1) Why Redwood: unified runtime optimizes for throughput and latency; typical customers see 40-70% reduction in token cost via batching + KV caching on like-for-like workloads.
2) Risk mitigations: SOC 2 report + VPC/private deployment options; we support customer-managed KMS and detailed audit logs.
3) Business impact (quantified): sample before/after for a 10M txn/month flow - expected reduction in manual FTE hours by ~3 FTEs and error-related chargebacks reduced by ~25%. Estimated gross run-rate savings: $420k/year (attachment shows assumptions).
4) Ask for Alex: 20-30 minute briefing to confirm cost model assumptions and get alignment for procurement timeline.

Proposed procurement call agenda (30m):
- Introductions (5m)
- High-level architecture & controls (10m)
- Commercial terms & timeline (10m)
- Next steps & action owners (5m)

I'll attach the ROI one-pager and a short champion enablement stub. Markus - can you add any technical risk notes we should surface to Nicole?

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.com
